name: Validate Project Assignment Role
Create Timesheet From Task
script:
if doc.custom_assign_employee:

    # Get Task creation datetime
    task_created = frappe.utils.get_datetime(doc.creation)

    # Get only the creation date
    task_created_date = task_created.date()


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Find Timesheets belonging to this Employee
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    timesheets = frappe.db.get_all(
        "Timesheet",
        filters={
            "employee": doc.custom_assign_employee
        },
        fields=[
            "name",
            "creation"
        ],
        order_by="creation desc"
    )


    existing_timesheet = None


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Find Timesheet created on the same date
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for ts in timesheets:

        timesheet_created = frappe.utils.get_datetime(
            ts.creation
        )

        timesheet_created_date = timesheet_created.date()


        if timesheet_created_date == task_created_date:

            existing_timesheet = ts.name
            break


    # ========================================================
    # EXISTING TIMESHEET FOUND
    # ========================================================

    if existing_timesheet:

        timesheet = frappe.get_doc(
            "Timesheet",
            existing_timesheet
        )


        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Check whether this Task is already in Timesheet
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        task_exists = False

        for row in timesheet.time_logs:

            if row.task == doc.name:

                task_exists = True
                break


        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Add Task if it is not already present
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        if not task_exists:

            time_log = timesheet.append(
                "time_logs",
                {}
            )


            # Activity Type
            if doc.custom_activity_type:

                time_log.activity_type = (
                    doc.custom_activity_type
                )


            # Project
            if doc.project:

                time_log.project = doc.project


            # Task
            time_log.task = doc.name


            # Description
            time_log.description = (
                "Task added automatically: " + doc.name
            )


            # IMPORTANT:
            # Do NOT set:
            #
            # from_time
            # to_time
            # hours


            timesheet.save(
                ignore_permissions=True
            )


            frappe.msgprint(
                "Task added to today's Timesheet: "
                + timesheet.name
            )


    # ========================================================
    # NO TIMESHEET FOUND
    # ========================================================

    else:

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Create new Timesheet
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        timesheet = frappe.new_doc(
            "Timesheet"
        )


        # Employee
        timesheet.employee = (
            doc.custom_assign_employee
        )


        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Add first Task
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        time_log = timesheet.append(
            "time_logs",
            {}
        )


        # Activity Type
        if doc.custom_activity_type:

            time_log.activity_type = (
                doc.custom_activity_type
            )


        # Project
        if doc.project:

            time_log.project = doc.project


        # Task
        time_log.task = doc.name


        # Description
        time_log.description = (
            "Task added automatically: " + doc.name
        )


        # IMPORTANT:
        # Do NOT set:
        #
        # from_time
        # to_time
        # hours


        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Create Timesheet
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        timesheet.insert(
            ignore_permissions=True
        )


        frappe.msgprint(
            "New Timesheet created: "
            + timesheet.name
        )
